project: Conan — v4.2: Tremor charting + aggressive Tauri-only cleanup
description: v4.2 does two things to the Tauri terminal-wrapper: (1) an aggressive Tauri-only cleanup — trim the gateway to only the routes the app calls (health, config, tasks, terminals, sessions list, sessions/:id/widgets, usage, pulse, events ingestion, the two WebSockets) and delete everything else (the observe/drive route surface, the browser/web-served + TLS/remote-access + pm2 path, and the v1→v4 planning history); and (2) adopt Tremor (Tremor Raw, the Tailwind-v4-native copy-in components — NOT @tremor/react) as the charting library going forward, migrating the Pulse stacked-area chart and the Context % ring. Cleanup (subtraction) is sequenced before Tremor (addition) so the surface is small first; the build stays green at every story. Source: docs/v4.2-backlog.md. Charting research (the resolved Tailwind-v4 risk): docs/v4.2-research.md. Note: going Tauri-only drops the gateway's browser SPA serving, so UI verification shifts to the Vite dev server at http://localhost:5173 (run `cd ui && npm run dev` alongside a gateway started with `npm start`).

userStories.title: Capture the real /context breakdown from the live pty into the Context widget
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Context widget to show the exact /context information for my live session — model header, total/window %, and the per-category breakdown including Free space — captured from the terminal, not just estimated from disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a /context capture for the correlated live session: parse Claude Code's rendered /context frame from the terminal pty (strip ANSI as in src/usage/probe.ts) into a typed result — model slug + display name, total/context-window tokens + %, and per-category tokens+% for System prompt, System tools, MCP tools, Memory files, Skills, Messages, and Free space
PASSIVE capture: when a /context frame appears in the correlated pty's output stream (the user ran it themselves), detect + parse + cache it for that session WITHOUT injecting anything

On-demand refresh: a control on the Context widget injects `/context` into the correlated pty (reusing the v4 keystroke-injection path) and captures the resulting frame; the control is hidden/disabled when no live pty is correlated
The frame parser is pure, exported, and unit-tested against a captured sample /context frame (scripts/test-context.mjs), mirroring parseUsageFrame in src/usage/probe.ts

Surface via the gateway (extend the widgets payload or add GET /api/claude/context) consumed by ContextWidget; the widget renders the exact categories + model header + Free space row matching the /context layout, labeled 'live · from /context'
Fall back to the existing on-disk estimate (labeled '≈ estimated') when no captured frame exists for the session — never blank
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean

Verify with automate-browser at http://localhost:5173 that after a /context run (or Refresh) the widget shows the exact categories/tokens/% including Free space + the model header, and that with no live session it falls back to the estimate
userStories.notes: /context is SESSION-SPECIFIC, so it must come from the correlated live pty (not a throwaway claude like the /usage probe). Anchors: src/usage/probe.ts (ANSI strip + bounded scrape + pure testable parser), src/terminal/correlate.ts (pty↔session correlation + the v4 keystroke injection), Widgets.tsx ContextWidget + ContextBreakdownBar, useWidgets. Depends on US-008 (ProgressCircle gauge). The disk estimate stays as the fallback — US-004 preserves its MCP/skills/memory readers. Gateway/terminal edits → run outside the in-dock session (footgun #1).

Surface via the usage route consumed by UsageWidget; the widget renders the Session stats + all three windows matching the /usage layout, labeled by source (live · from /usage vs plan · probe vs ≈ approx)
Source precedence, never blank: live captured frame → throwaway-probe windows → the US-004 token-trend baseline
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Native OS notifications surfacing Claude's prompts (from the Notification hook) for the user to acknowledge
userStories.description: As a user working in another app, I want a native macOS notification when a Claude session in Conan needs me — a permission prompt or waiting for input — so I'm pulled back to acknowledge/answer it instead of missing it.
acceptanceCriteria: Add the Tauri notification plugin: @tauri-apps/plugin-notification (JS) + tauri-plugin-notification (Cargo) registered in src-tauri/src/lib.rs, a notification capability in src-tauri/capabilities/default.json, and request permission on first use (isPermissionGranted/requestPermission); respect denial gracefully

Trigger from the app WS: when a `Notification` hook event arrives (already ingested via POST /api/claude/events and broadcast over /ws as {type:'event'} with hook_event_name='Notification'), fire a native OS notification whose title identifies the session (name/short id or cwd) and whose body is the hook payload's `message` (e.g. 'Claude needs your permission to use …' / 'waiting for your input')

Only fire when the user would otherwise miss it: suppress when the Conan window is focused AND the correlated terminal is visible; de-dupe/throttle repeat Notification events for the same session so it never spams
Clicking the notification brings Conan to the foreground (and, if feasible, selects the correlated terminal tab) so the user can acknowledge/answer the prompt in the terminal
Guard everything with isTauri(); in the browser dev view fall back to the existing in-app Toaster (no native API)

Native notifications can't be verified headlessly — gate on typecheck + ui build green + the wiring, and document the manual check (trigger a permission prompt → a macOS banner appears with the prompt text → clicking focuses Conan) in progress.txt
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
userStories.notes: Trigger source verified: the `Notification` hook is already installed (.claude/settings.json → scripts/hooks/send-event.mjs → POST /api/claude/events → /ws), and its payload carries `message`. Surfacing it over the WS is read-only — no new gateway route. Adding the plugin regenerates src-tauri/gen/schemas + needs a tauri dev restart (Rust recompile). STRETCH (note only, not required): interactive Allow/Deny notification actions that route the answer to the correlated pty via the v4 keystroke-injection path (src/terminal/correlate.ts) — macOS notification action-button support is limited, so base scope is notify + click-to-focus. Run Rust/gateway/terminal edits outside the in-dock session (footgun #1).
